correctness.rationale: Kneser with stabilizer H implies (p-3)p^{a-1}/2<4|H|; for p≥11 contradicts |H|≤p^{a-1}; at p=7 only index-seven H survives, but strict majority projects to at least two classes and six sums of any two distinct mod-seven classes cover all seven. The 5-sum witness {1,2} modulo seven misses 4. Exhaustive and seeded finite checks corroborate, not substitute for, proof.

value.rationale: The optimal uniform local additive-basis order is a natural cutoff in quadratic-residue Waring covering, and improves the motivating half-density guarantee from ten to exactly six over all prime powers p≥7, including the exceptional smallest admissible prime. Sharpness at p=7 supplies a boundary obstruction; the proof is short but the exact uniform cutoff is not merely a renamed special case of either cited theorem.
